rows.text_en: Ministry of National Defense (Facilities Planning Division), 02-748-5641

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「국방ㆍ군사시설 사업에 관한 법률」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of these Rules is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on National Defense and Military Facilities Projects and its Enforcement Decree and other matters necessary for their enforcement.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(국방ㆍ군사시설사업계획의 승인 등 신청) ① 「국방ㆍ군사시설 사업에 관한 법률 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제3조제1항에 따른 국방ㆍ군사시설사업계획 승인신청서는 별지 제1호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Applications for Approval of National Defense and Military Facilities Project Plans, etc.) ① Applications for approval of a national defense and military facilities project plan under Article 3 (1) of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on National Defense and Military Facilities Projects (hereinafter referred to as the "Decree") shall use Form No. 1.

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제3조제2항에 따른 국방ㆍ군사시설사업계획 변경승인 또는 폐지승인 신청서는 별지 제2호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ② Applications for approval of changes to, or abolition of, a national defense and military facilities project plan under Article 3 (2) of the Decree shall use Form No. 2.

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항 및 제2항에 따른 국방ㆍ군사시설사업계획 승인 또는 변경승인 신청을 받은 담당 공무원은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 사업예정지역의 토지ㆍ임야 대장 및 토지이용계획 확인서를 확인하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ An official receiving an application for approval of a national defense and military facilities project plan or approval of an amendment thereto under paragraph (1) or (2) shall verify the land and forest registers and land-use plan confirmation certificate for the proposed project area through shared administrative information under Article 36 (1) of the Electronic Government Act.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(국방ㆍ군사시설사업 실시계획의 승인 등 신청) ① 영 제4조제1항에 따른 국방ㆍ군사시설사업 실시계획 승인신청서는 별지 제3호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Applications for Approval of Implementation Plans for National Defense and Military Facilities Projects, etc.) ① Applications for approval of an implementation plan under Article 4 (1) of the Decree shall use Form No. 3.

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제4조제2항에 따른 국방ㆍ군사시설사업 실시계획 변경승인 또는 폐지승인 신청서는 별지 제4호서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: ② Applications for approval of changes to, or abolition of, an implementation plan under Article 4 (2) of the Decree shall use Form No. 4.

rows.source_ko: 제4조(건축등의 승인 신청) 영 제5조제1항에 따라 국방ㆍ군사시설 건축ㆍ축조ㆍ대수선ㆍ용도변경(이하 “건축등”이라 한다)의 승인을 받으려는 사업시행자는 별지 제5호서식의 국방ㆍ군사시설 건축등 승인신청서에 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 서류를 첨부하여 국방부장관에게 제출하여야 한다. 이 경우 국방ㆍ군사시설 건축의 승인 신청을 받은 담당 공무원은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 건축할 대지의 지적도(地籍圖)를 확인하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Applications for Approval of Construction, etc.) A project implementer wishing to obtain approval under Article 5 (1) of the Decree for building construction, erection of structures, major repairs, or changes of use of national defense and military facilities (hereinafter referred to as "construction, etc.") shall submit an application in Form No. 5 to the Minister of National Defense with the documents specified below. The official receiving an application for approval of building construction shall verify the cadastral map of the proposed site through shared administrative information under Article 36 (1) of the Electronic Government Act.
1. For building construction of national defense and military facilities:

rows.source_ko: 가. 건축할 대지의 소유 또는 사용에 관한 권리를 증명하는 서류 1부
rows.text_en: (a) One copy of documents proving ownership of, or rights to use, the proposed building site
(b) One copy of a building construction plan
(c) One copy of a site layout plan
2. For erection of national defense and military structures:
(a) One copy of a site layout plan
(b) One copy of structural drawings
3. For major repairs of national defense and military facilities:
(a) One copy of the floor plan of the floor to be substantially repaired
(b) One copy of a sectional drawing of the floor to be substantially repaired
4. For changes of use of national defense and military facilities:

rows.source_ko: 가. 용도를 변경하려는 층의 변경 전 및 변경 후의 평면도 각 1부
rows.text_en: (a) One copy each of the floor plans before and after the change of use for the relevant floor

rows.source_ko: 나. 용도변경에 따라 변경되는 내화ㆍ내장ㆍ방화 또는 피난 건축설비에 관한 도서(圖書) 각 1부
rows.text_en: (b) One copy each of the documents on fire-resistant construction, interior finishes, fire-prevention facilities, or evacuation facilities that will be changed as a result of the change of use

rows.source_ko: 제5조(준공검사 등) 사업시행자는 국방ㆍ군사시설의 건축등을 마쳤을 때에는 별지 제6호서식의 준공검사 신청서에 공사감리보고서 및 현황 도면 각 1부를 첨부하여 국방부장관에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Completion Inspections, etc.) Upon completing construction, etc. of national defense and military facilities, a project implementer shall submit an application for completion inspection in Form No. 6 to the Minister of National Defense, together with one copy each of a construction supervision report and drawings showing the current condition.
ADDENDA <Ministry of National Defense Decree No. 756, Jan. 26, 2012>
These Rules shall enter into force on Jan. 26, 2012.
